ogtr:DIR-186.name: DIR 186 — GM wheat & barley field trial (yield + abiotic stress)
ogtr:DIR-186.type: GM wheat and barley field trial
ogtr:DIR-186.desc: Field trial of wheat and barley genetically modified for yield enhancement and improved abiotic stress tolerance. One site in Light Regional Council, South Australia, maximum two hectares per year, April 2022 to January 2027. Licence conditions require isolation from other wheat and barley, secure transport and storage, and end-of-trial destruction verified by site inspection.
